name: Componentwise coefficient-tensor tightening of the full N=1 exact-preconditioned radius

statement.latest: A=J_0^{-1},\quad H_j^{cw}\text{ from exact coefficientwise majorization},\quad S_{cw}=\max_i\sum_j|A_{ij}|H_j^{cw},\quad r_{cw}=\frac{1}{2S_{cw}};\qquad 10^{-28}<r_{cw}\le10^{-27}
statement.note_ascii: the exact 52x52x52 integer coefficient tensor of the C-scaled N=1 Galerkin bilinear map is used to propagate componentwise state, first-derivative, and second-derivative majorants on a rational local box; combining these row Hessian bounds with the exact rational inverse J0^-1 yields q<=1/2 at a radius between 10^-28 and 10^-27

definitions.T: exact integer coefficient tensor of the scaled finite N=1 Galerkin bilinear map; the reproduced tensor has 2096 nonzero coefficients and induced infinity row-sum bound 36000
definitions.H_j_cw: componentwise propagated exact rational l1 Hessian-row majorant for selected observation j on the declared radius-1/1000 local box
definitions.A: exact characteristic-zero rational inverse J_0^{-1} from PROP-EPSC-27
definitions.r_cw: finite infinity-norm state-space radius 1/(2 S_cw), certified to lie inside the declared local box

parents.evidence: the exact rational center inverse removes determinant-bound slack before local nonlinear variation is bounded
the componentwise recurrence provides the certified local Jacobian-variation bound required for q<1
the reproduced rigorous radius improves from the exact-preconditioner 10^-59 scale to the 10^-28 scale, while practical measurement/noise branch stability remains open

claim_boundary: Fixed finite N=1 local certificate only. The 10^-28 to 10^-27 radius is a conservative state-space inverse neighborhood, not a practical sensor/noise tolerance. It does not establish global branch uniqueness, arbitrary-N inversion, all-N saturation, continuum regularity or singularity, physical DNS adequacy, or the Clay result.
